eventScripts.script:
logger = system.util.getLogger("DebugTrigger")
	logger.info("initialChange=%s | currentValue.value=%s | tagPath=%s" % (initialChange, currentValue.value, tagPath))
	
	if not initialChange and currentValue.value:
			logger.info("PASSED IF CHECK - entering block")
			
			tubenum = system.tag.readBlocking(["[.]TubeNum"])[0].value
			logger.info("tubenum=%s" % tubenum)
			
			path_to_Tube = "[default]/Tubes/Tube" + str(tubenum) 
			path_to_Fish = path_to_Tube  + "/FishOut/ScanData"
			path_to_SortType = path_to_Tube + "/FishOut/SortType"
			path_to_dataTrigger = path_to_Tube + "/NonPLCTriggers/TriggerWriteSQL"
			
			fish_data = system.tag.readBlocking(
				[path_to_Fish]
			)[0].value
			
			sorting_data = system.tag.readBlocking(
				[path_to_SortType]
			)[0].value
			
			logger.info("fish_data=%s | sorting_data=%s" % (fish_data, sorting_data))
			
			split_data = fish_data.split(';')
			
			try: 
				
			  	query= """
					INSERT INTO sorting.fish (
					file_id_aris,
				    tag_num,
					filename1,
					filename2,
				    site,
					date,
					time,
					priority,
					prioritygate, 
					speed,
					length,
					circumference,
					weight,
					area,
					condition,
					maturity,
					deformity,
					gate,
					outputlane,
					outputlanereason
					)
				    VALUES(?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)
				    """
				
				system.db.runPrepUpdate(
					query,
					[
						split_data[0],
					    split_data[1],
						split_data[2],
						split_data[3],
						split_data[4],
						split_data[5],
						split_data[6],
						split_data[7],
						split_data[8],
						split_data[9],
						split_data[10],
						split_data[11],
						split_data[12],
						split_data[13],
						split_data[14],
						split_data[15],
						split_data[16],
						split_data[17],
						str(tubenum),
						sorting_data
					 ],
					"passageportaldb"
					)
				
				log_s = "Sql write succesful " + str(tubenum) 
				logger.info(log_s)
				system.tag.writeBlocking([path_to_dataTrigger], [False])
				
			
			except Exception, e:
				return e
				
	else:
		logger.info("No DB Write was executed")
